prompt:
An evaluation pack contains 8 questions. Every one has the expected answer 'fail', because each was written from a real defect. The pack is scored solely on whether the stated verdict matches the expected one; nothing else contributes to the score.

Decide whether this pack can distinguish a model that understands the questions from one that answers 'fail' every time without reading them.

Verdict convention: answer `pass` if the thing described is sound as it stands, and `fail` if it is defective. The verdict describes the thing under review, never any proposal mentioned about it.
